# Character enrichment sources

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:

- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.

- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their

entries.text: A variant of 袿 gown, with 卦# replacing 圭 → *gown*; *overcoat*. Also, a type of *ceremonial clothing* during the Manchu Dynasty.
衣 clothing + 妻 for the sound つま (not "wife" but a homonym) referring to the *skirt/fringe* of a kimono.
衣厚褆褆。从衣是聲。
As per 复# as described in 腹 (double back) + 衣 clothing → *double-layered article of clothing* → (article of) *clothing*; *overlap*; *double*; *multiply*; *plural*.
重衣皃。从衣复聲。一曰褚衣。

復.evidenceScope: 2013 appendix and OpenCC 1.4.2 phrase example. Note that the dataset deliberately excludes 复→覆 as a current standalone conversion.

sources.basis: Lexical example explicitly found in OpenCC 1.4.2 STPhrases

entries.text: As per 扁# (spread, but remain in contact) + 衣 clothing → *tight-fitting (undersized) garment* → *narrow*. *Narrow-mindedness* is a borrowed meaning, via 惼.
衣小也。从衣扁聲。
As per 軍# (circularity) + 衣 clothing → clothing wrapped about the waist (and/or leg) → *loincloth*.
衣正幅。从衣耑聲。

褏 is as per 由# (pass/run through) + 裒 (collect/gather) → run the arm through *sleeves* (compare 袖) that gather about the arm → *fancy, conspicuous clothing*. In Japan, 褏 has been supplanted by 褎, which replaces 由 with 禾.
袂也。从衣𥝩聲。

As per 曷# (cut off) + 衣 clothing → coarse, dark cloth cut to make clothing → *coarse cloth* → *brown*. *Dark blue* also derives from the primary meaning, the clothes of low-ranking retainers in ancient Japan having been cut from coarse blue cloth.
編枲韤。一曰粗衣。从衣曷聲。

As per 保# (cover) + 衣 clothing → large/loose-fitting robe or other clothes that cover the body → large. *Praise*, *commend* and *reward* are borrowed meanings. Compare and contrast 褓, which too is composed of 保 + 衣 (the latter in the form 衤).

As per 保# (cover) + 衣 clothing → cloth for carrying a baby on one's back → *infant's clothing*; *diaper* (compare 呆 and 襁). 褓 was devised to replace 保 after 保 acquired its associated meanings. Compare and contrast 褒, which too is composed of 保 + 衣.
翟，羽飾衣。从衣俞聲。一曰直裾謂之襜褕。
䙔領也。从衣匽聲。
As per 韋# (go around) + 衣 clothing → *ceremonial gown* wrapped about a queen.
蔽厀也。从衣韋聲。《周禮》曰：“王后之服褘衣。”謂畫袍。
As per 者# (pile) + 衣 clothing → *pad a garment with cotton*; *cotton-stuffed garment* (← pile of cotton). Also, a *bag* (originally, one in which to stuff clothes).
卒也。从衣者聲。一曰製衣。
As per 𥁕# as described in 温 (hold in/down) + 衣 clothing → padded *robe* (compare 袁) that holds in heat.
袖也。一曰藏也。从衣鬼聲。
As per 辱# (soft) + 衣 clothing → soft cloth(ing) (compare 襦) → *mat*; *bedding*; *cushion*.
耿# clear + 衣 clothing → *unlined garment* (← transparent material ← clear). Compare 絅.
檾也。《詩》曰：“衣錦褧衣。”示反古。从衣耿聲。
As per 退# (drop) + 衣 clothing → strip off clothes; cause clothes to drop in undressing → *fade* (← color that "drops" from fabric).
As per 虒# as described in 遞 (sequential) + 衣 clothing → *strip/tear off* (garments in sequence); *denude* → *seize*.
奪衣也。从衣虒聲。讀若池。
以組帶馬也。从衣从馬。
鬼衣。从衣，熒省聲。讀若《詩》曰“葛藟縈之”。一曰若“靜女其袾”之袾。
As per the upper element# of 寒 (raise in layers) + 衣 clothing → *raise* a *garment covering the lower half of the body*. Compare 摳.
絝也。从衣，寒省聲。《春秋傳》曰：“徵褰與襦。”
俠也。从衣眔聲。一曰橐。
As per 庫# (cover) + 衣 clothing → *pants/trousers* covering the U-shaped crotch.
As per 習# (press flat) + 衣 clothing → pleat/creases pressed upon each other → *pleat*; *crease*. Also, *lined kimono* (layered garment).
As per 婁# (continuum) + 衣 clothing → *rags* stitched together into a single garment. Compare 襴.
衽也。从衣婁聲。

As per 埶# (cut) + 衣 clothing → cut cloth for use as underwear → *be familiar* (← be on as close terms with something/someone as with one's own underwear); *dirty* (← soiled underwear) → *treat with disrespect*.
私服。从衣埶聲。《詩》曰：“是褻袢也。”
帴也。从衣曹聲。

強# strong + 衣 clothing → cloth tied tightly (= strongly) about part of the body → *cord stretched tautly* (about an infant carried on one's back); *swaddling clothes*. Also *diaper*, another type of cloth-based product used by infants.
負兒衣。从衣强聲。
衣博裾。从衣，𠊻省聲。𠊻，古文𠈃。

The relevant seal inscription form shows a number of mixed items + 衣 clothing (here suggesting a supple/soft cloth sack) → *cooperate* in inserting seized goods in sacks → *work*; *assist* → *aid*; *help*. *Raise* is a borrowed meaning.
漢令：解衣耕謂之襄。从衣𤕦聲。
衣領也。从衣棘聲。《詩》曰：“要之襋之。”
單# single 衣 clothing → *single-layered (= unlined) garment* → *unlined kimono*; *undergarment*.
衣不重。从衣單聲。
飾也。从衣象聲。
衣博大。从衣尋聲。
奧# deep + 衣 clothing → lined/padded *outer garments* (that encase the body deeply). *Fusuma* (sliding paper doors) is a borrowed meaning.
𧚍屬。从衣奥聲。
絝也。从衣睪聲。
帶所結也。从衣會聲。《春秋傳》曰：“衣有襘。”
衣死人也。从衣遂聲。《春秋傳》曰：“楚使公親襚。”
衣厚皃。从衣農聲。《詩》曰：“何彼襛矣。”
As per 詹# (bear a burden) + 衣 clothing → heavy garment burdening the wearer → *lap robe*; *pendent, concealing garment/cloth*.
衣蔽前。从衣詹聲。
As per 辟# (spread) + 衣 clothing → spreading *pleats* → *crease*; *folds*.
韏衣也。从衣辟聲。
As per 禁# (contain) + 衣 clothing → outer layer of clothing containing one beneath it → *collar*. Compare 衿.
短衣也。从衣蜀聲。讀若蜀。
As per 亶# (long and flat) + 衣 clothing → *strip* to one's undergarments, flattening one's appearance.
監 here an abbreviated form# of 濫 disorder + 衣 clothing → *ragged/tattered*, disorderly clothing → *rags*.
裯謂之襤褸。襤，無緣也。从衣監聲。
As per 需# (soft) + 衣 clothing → soft fabric of a garment (compare 褥) → fine silk cloth → *underwear*.
短衣也。从衣需聲。一曰㬮衣。
As per 蔑# (obscure) + 衣 clothing → *socks* (obscure on account of being hidden in shoes; compare 韈).
As per 頡# (gather) + 衣 clothing → gather/*tuck* up the hem of a garment.
以衣衽扱物謂之襭。从衣頡聲。
黼領也。从衣㬥聲。《詩》曰：“素衣朱𧟊。”
As per 親# (intimate) + 衣 clothing → intimate garments → *underwear* → *approach*; *draw near*.
絝踦也。从衣龍聲。

龖 is 龍 dragon (doubled) → dragons pressed closely together in flight. 襲 combines 龍 (an abbreviated form# of 龖) + 衣 clothing → wear layers of clothing (← double/pile up garments) → *inherit*; *succeed to* (← add goods, offices etc. to those already in one's possession). Also, *attack*; *sweep over* and *seize* (← attack like dragons in flight).
左衽袍。从衣，龖省聲。
As per 闌# (link) + 衣 clothing → pieces of cloth linked to form a *one-piece garment*. Compare 褸.
擧 raise + 衣 clothing → *sash/cord* to tie up the sleeves of one's kimono.
袍衣也。从衣繭聲。以絮曰襺，以緼曰袍。《春秋傳》曰：“盛夏重襺。”
A depiction of a square or rectangular container with a *cover* placed atop it → *place atop/upon*. Compare 於.
覆也。从冂，上下覆之。凡襾之屬皆从襾。讀若𣇩。

A depiction of a nest in which chicks are neatly aligned. *West* is either a borrowed or an extended meaning; in the latter case the idea might be that of the reddish sun aligned with the horizon at sunset. (For "reddish," compare 茜.) By further extension is *the Pure Land*, Buddhism having entered China from lands west.
鳥在巢上。象形。日在西方而鳥棲，故因以爲東西之西。凡西之屬皆从西。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 女 woman + an element combining a pair of hands and a backbone → compress a woman's waist, creating curvaceous hips → waist; hips → *main point*; *vital* (← hips as the pivot point of the body) → *brief*; *sum up*; *in short*. Also, *demand* (← demand that which is vital to one) → *want*; *need*; *require*.
身中也。象人要自𦥑之形。从𦥑，交省聲。
反覆也。从襾乏聲。
Originally, an abbreviated form# of 鹽 (container of salt) + 西 (nest-like object) → *deep and wide* container → *extensive*.

As per 復# (double back) + 襾 cover → boat that is blown back in a breeze and overturns, becoming covered in water → *capsize*; *turn over*; *overturn*; *turn back*. Associated and extended meanings include *overthrow*, *overrule* and *disprove*, as well as *cover* and *spread over*.
覂也。一曰蓋也。从襾復聲。

霸 is 雨 rain/natural phenomena + an element combining 革# (stretch tautly) and 月 moon → strain (figuratively "stretch") the eyes to observe the whitish moon spreading over the daytime sky. *Domination* and *dominion* are borrowed meanings. 霸 has been supplanted by the form 覇.
實也。考事，襾笮邀遮，其辤得實曰覈。从襾敫聲。

儿# human figure + 目 eye → person whose sight is fixed on an object he is being shown → *see*; *look*; *observe*; *be visible/in sight*; *appear*; *viewpoint*. Also, *show*, *examine*, and *care for* (← observe) → *make a pretense of* (← for show alone). A seal inscription form rotates the eye vertically.
視也。从儿从目。凡見之屬皆从見。
冕也。周曰覍，殷曰吁，夏曰收。从皃，象形。

The relevant seal inscription form of the left-hand element# is an ancient, *compass*-like measuring implement. + 見 see → observe in taking measurements" → *measure*; *standard*; *plan*; *place limits upon*.
有法度也。从夫从見。
擇也。从見毛聲。讀若苗。
Originally an abbreviated form# of 眽 gaze + 見 see → gaze in seeking → *seek*.
蔽不相見也。从見必聲。
Originally 示 altar/the supernatural + part of a compass-like implement (now written 見; compare 規) → compass-like implement used in divination rites → *sight*; *vision* (← envision the future).
瞻也。从見、示。
As per 司# (peer through a hole) + 見 see → *peep*; *peek*. 覗 was devised to replace 司 after 司 came to convey the meaning "administer."
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 見 (affix one's sight on) → fix a (surreptitious) look on someone/something → *peep*; *peek at*; *spy on*; *watch*. Compare 眈.
窺也。从見占聲。《春秋傳》曰：“公使覘之，信。”
衺視也。从𠂢从見。
諸矦三年大相聘曰頫。頫，視也。从見兆聲。
察視也。从見㶣聲。讀若鎌。
竝視也。从二見。凡覞之屬皆从覞。
巫# sorcery + 見 see → *male diviner/medium*; *male shrine servant*.
能齋肅事神明也。在男曰覡，在女曰巫。从巫从見。
暫見也。从見炎聲。《春秋公羊傳》曰：“覢然公子陽生。”
好視也。从見委聲。
兪# remove + 見 (affix one's sight on) → secretly *wish for/covet* (← look for a prized object that has been taken away/removed).
欲也。从見俞聲。

The left-hand element# as described in 新 (sharp, and in close proximity) + 見 see; watch → observe others sharply → *parent*; *relative*; *intimate* (← be in a close relationship and receive direct stimulus); *group leader*.
至也。从見亲聲。
As per 豈# (pile of food on a stand) + 見 (affix one's sight on) → *covet* (← covet food). Usually, the nuance is that of coveting something above one's station, or otherwise unreasonable.
㰟𡴘也。从見豈聲。
小見也。从見冥聲。《爾雅》曰：“覭髳，弗離。”
As per 冓# (symmetry) + 見 see → *meet someone unexpectedly*, forming a pair. Compare 遇.
遇見也。从見冓聲。
虘# take aim + 見 see → *observe*; *spy on*; *be on the watch for*.
拘覰，未致密也。从見虘聲。
𦰩 as described in 漢, here an abbreviated form# of 謹 humility + 見 see → *imperial audience*.
諸矦秋朝曰覲，勞王事。从見堇聲。
好視也。从見𤔔聲。
司也。从見微聲。

As per 𦥯# as described in 學 (obtain knowledge) + 見 see → be stimulated to obtain knowledge, and *realize* its acquisition → *learn*; *awaken*; *come to one's senses*; (Buddhist) *enlightenment* → *remember*; *memory*; *bear in mind*; *feel*.
寤也。从見，學省聲。一曰發也。
An abbreviated form# of 監 keep watch over + 見 see (for emphasis/clarification) → keep watch over objects from a high vantage point → *look out over*; *survey*; *see*.
觀也。从見、監，監亦聲。
賣# sell + 見 see → (sellers and buyers who) *see* each other in transacting business → *meet* face to face; (have/grant an) *interview*.
見也。从見𧸇聲。
As per 雚# as described in 勸 (circular uniformity) + 見 see → panoramic *view* (compare 睘 as described in 環) → *look*; *see*; *appearance*.
諦視也。从見雚聲。
A depiction of a hard, curved *horn* → *corner*; *edge*; *angle* → *harshness*.
獸角也。象形，角與刀、魚相似。凡角之屬皆从角。
角皃。从角丩聲。《詩》曰：“兕觵其觓。”

As per 夬# (scoop out) + 角 horn → *damaged horn* (← chipped/nicked, creating a hole) → *damaged* → *be dissatisfied* (← unsatisfactory condition) → *wish for* (← wish for a solution to a situation that dissatisfies one).
瓜# melon (→ shape indicator) + 角 horn → *large (wide-mouthed) goblet*, originally one made of horn. Also via shape association, 觚 indicates an *inscribed wooden placard*.
鄉飮酒之爵也。一曰觴受三升者謂之觚。从角瓜聲。
小觶也。从角旦聲。
As per 此# (line up irregularly) + 角 horn → irregularly shaped *beak/bill* (compare 嘴).
鴟舊頭上角觜也。一曰觜觿也。从角此聲。
As per 氐# (press) + 角 horn → *butt* horns/heads; *touch*; *come into contact with*. Compare 牴 and 羝.
牝牂羊生角者也。从角圭聲。
曲角也。从角𢍏聲。
骨角之名也。从角各聲。
一角仰也。从角㓞聲。《易》曰：“其牛觢。”

角# horn + an element combining 刀 sword/knife and 牛 cow → *remove* cattle horns in butchering → *dismember*; *break*; *release*; *unravel*; *disentangle*; *untie*; *loosen*; *solve*; *melt* → *understand*; *explain* → *dispel* (← dispel doubts and obtain understanding) → *cancel*. *Comb* is by extension from "disentangle."
判也。从刀判牛角。一曰解𢊁，獸也。
羊角不齊也。从角危聲。
As per 光# (extend) + 角 horn → wide *goblet* made of rhino horn. Compare 觳.
角觬曲也。从角兒聲。西河有觬氏縣。
角一俛一仰也。从角奇聲。
觰拏，獸也。从角者聲。一曰下大者也。
用角低仰便也。从羊、牛、角。《詩》曰：“觲觲角弓。”
An abbreviated form# of 殼 (hard husk) + 角 horn → *goblet* made of horn (compare 觥) → a *measure of volume*.
盛觵卮也。一曰射具。从角㱿聲。讀若斛。
As per the right-hand element# of 傷 (raise the hand) + 角 horn → raise a *goblet*/*wine vessel*/*cup* made of horn in proposing a toast.
觶實曰觴，虚曰觶。从角，𥏻省聲。
兕牛角可以飲者也。从角黃聲。其狀觵觵，故謂之觵。
單# single + 角 horn → *goblet* carved from a single horn.
鄉飲酒角也。《禮》曰：“一人洗，舉觶。”觶受四升。从角單聲。
治角也。从角，學省聲。

As per 蜀# (insect adhering to a leaf) + 角 horn (→ insect feelers) → the feelers of an insect adhering to the surface of the object they *touch* → *feel*; *strike* → *take in*; *perceive*; *touch upon*; *contrary to/in violation of* (← touch or figuratively upon something prohibited).
抵也。从角蜀聲。
角也。从角樂聲。張掖有觻得縣。
環之有舌者。从角敻聲。
As per 雟# (carry) + 角 horn → horn or ivory *bodkin* (carried on one's person).
佩角，銳耑可以解結。从角巂聲。《詩》曰：“童子佩觿。”
